notes.title: Chapter 02 Update: The Wrist Device, New SCP & The First Playtest!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey everyone![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We're back with another update on the development of Chapter 02. The team has been hard at work bringing the next areas of Site-113 to life, focusing on the core environments and the creatures and anomalies that now inhabit them. Things are shaping up to be truly terrifying, so let's get into what we've been building![/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Areas and Environmental Improvements:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_c2d18b90562b45f885798136ebcbd365~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_c2d18b90562b45f885798136ebcbd365~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_7df82c96c3d1494f9f3c702499546260~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_7df82c96c3d1494f9f3c702499546260~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_b8e2e2e81a07454da09573910afa4c2a~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_b8e2e2e81a07454da09573910afa4c2a~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_30be285ac09844018333db4ffe76ddcb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_30be285ac09844018333db4ffe76ddcb~mv2.webp"][/img]
In the last update, we showed the updated North Wing, which has since been completed architecturally and will be getting a prop and detail pass shortly. This area has some unique interactions with the world planned, and also features a very striking view of some of the other zones in the game![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Terminal 07 Tram Station:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_02e5e379106649faa6e1ece5f764e767~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_02e5e379106649faa6e1ece5f764e767~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_db272b44ee6a481e90bdd7ce750de8cb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_db272b44ee6a481e90bdd7ce750de8cb~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_d4650f378b03495e9ca5cab6f0d6a3fb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_d4650f378b03495e9ca5cab6f0d6a3fb~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_11a28a5eb695435bbe4f1e8b5adebe38~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_11a28a5eb695435bbe4f1e8b5adebe38~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p]Those of you who played Chapter 01 will remember that the game ends on a train heading into the interior dome of the facility. This new area is the other side of that tram station and serves as the starting point for Chapter 02. However, unlike the station in Chapter 01, you will be able to fully explore this one, finding important information about your team and other bits of the story before you continue deeper into the facility.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Interrogation Room:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_6a3bc852a9ce40b9976c779e0fa170e5~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_6a3bc852a9ce40b9976c779e0fa170e5~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_5dd565d3df914806b715ab83ae6974a6~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_5dd565d3df914806b715ab83ae6974a6~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p]Deep within the heart of the Residential Zone lies a dark, decrepit backroom where those found trespassing are taken to have valuable information coerced from them, details about what supplies they have, who sent them, and anything else deemed necessary to survive in the crumbling ruins of a dying facility...[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Overseers Office:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_e6a788320fe34094adf749fc2f60e137~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_e6a788320fe34094adf749fc2f60e137~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_3fd797d39c1041088d4932c153ccdf10~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_3fd797d39c1041088d4932c153ccdf10~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_7a4bd8a709b0439e8c3ac38ba7e7f99f~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_7a4bd8a709b0439e8c3ac38ba7e7f99f~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p]Last update, we showed the initial concept for the Overseer's Office, and we have now fully created the architecture for this area. This location in Chapter 02 is extremely important; not only will you uncover a huge piece of the story, but you will also acquire a tool that fundamentally changes how the game is played. It's also preceded by a unique puzzle sequence that we are very excited for players to try out during the upcoming playtesting session.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Museum:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_a1b956f276bc4d1a9dc740b69421fe15~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_a1b956f276bc4d1a9dc740b69421fe15~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_680c02f4d7384fc5aa49169f0c741119~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_680c02f4d7384fc5aa49169f0c741119~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_123b9a3b0957437f84bfcadce3e06720~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_123b9a3b0957437f84bfcadce3e06720~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_f53e50b86a3f4cc493ac169b95332982~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_f53e50b86a3f4cc493ac169b95332982~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p]The Museum has received new lighting and extra props, as well as some cool holographic materials, which give the space a more interesting vibe. There will be a ton of story beats and other fun details about the SCP Foundation to learn about in here, so it's definitely worth checking out the exhibits to learn more about the history of Site-113. You will also find information about the past directors of the site and a timeline of important events in both the Foundation's and Earth's history.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Sewer Exit Hall:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_5b85328fc81f444a872994d8c144c65c~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_5b85328fc81f444a872994d8c144c65c~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][h3][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_6f62775649434a8090e2197f8b0ac0f6~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_6f62775649434a8090e2197f8b0ac0f6~mv2.webp"][/img][/h3][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_e023a2a0087445a89a7a06a431878c0d~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_e023a2a0087445a89a7a06a431878c0d~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_ef25180a20f04b6490623634ed23219a~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_ef25180a20f04b6490623634ed23219a~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p]One of our newest environments is the Sewer Exit Hall, which will be a fun traversal puzzle utilizing a unique piece of technology you will find somewhere in the game. We are incredibly excited to start testing zones like this, so be sure to check back for information on how YOU can start playtesting! Of course, this zone still needs a final decoration and lighting pass to get the moody, dark atmosphere featured in Chapter 01, which is something we will be focusing on shortly.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Ventilation Tunnels:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_aebbc1b6a70146d5a224ceba3dc0f0b4~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_aebbc1b6a70146d5a224ceba3dc0f0b4~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_5485d198d9c346ccaf2da7a404c24442~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_5485d198d9c346ccaf2da7a404c24442~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_0528bfdaace242e5b87cfd0aa17e2470~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_0528bfdaace242e5b87cfd0aa17e2470~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p]One of the first places you'll visit in Chapter 02 is this ventilation tunnel. Here, you will find interesting bits about your team, be introduced to new threats to worry about, and learn things that will become quite useful for getting through tough areas later on. This zone is currently undergoing its lighting pass, and we cannot wait to see how it turns out.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Wrist Device:[/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="oE7xAGn41-Y;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We've been hard at work designing and implementing the animations for the Wrist Device, a prototype short-range teleportation device powered by liquid Hume. This device will fundamentally change how traversal in the game works, and we are so excited for players to try it out. In this video, we can see how teleportation works, as well as the need to recharge the device from puddles of liquid Hume in the environment.[/p][p][/p][p]This is still a relatively early WIP, and we are currently working on its visual and sound effects, which we should be sharing in another update shortly. The Wrist Device will be one of the most critical mechanics to get feedback on in the upcoming playtest, so be sure to be there to let us know what you think![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Scranton Reality Anchors:[/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="xBCZr7I11qY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Another new mechanic working directly in tandem with the Wrist Device is the Scranton Reality Anchors (SRAs). These large devices are capable of anchoring nearby reality, causing objects in an unstable reality area to fall back to the floor. However, they are also capable of disrupting your Wrist Device, which will introduce a new decision for players to make. Disabling a reality anchor can have consequences on the environment that are bigger than one might expect...[/p][p][/p][h3][b]SCP-149 \[Heavy WIP]:[/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="hycOa6j575w;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The first flying enemy to be added to the game is SCP-149. These creepy bugs will be scattered around Chapter 02 and beyond and will serve as an environmental hazard that can (and maybe should) be avoided. These creatures are not only capable of swarming you to cause a lot of damage, but they are also able to infect you with a special virus -- which we will see below. These creatures are relatively docile until you threaten their nest, so it's wise to simply leave them alone.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Please note:[/b] These creatures are still very WIP and their attacks, damage amounts, and aggression will be balanced through several playtesting sessions as we proceed throughout development.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]SCP-149 Infection HUD WIP:[/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="cvDdzc2gAJM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Those that venture a little too close to an SCP-149 hive will find out very quickly that these creatures are no joke, as they can infect you with a virus that becomes progressively more severe through several distinct stages, until death eventually comes for you. Luckily, you'll be able to craft and find prototype cures for this infectious disease -- though those cures have problems of their own...[/p][p][/p][h3][b]MTF Field Symbols:[/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="E92ohuYEfUM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Something we showcased in a prior update was the ability to scan field symbols, and we have now added several new ones that can be found and scanned to give details and hints about the world around you. These symbols can provide interesting bits of information, mission objectives, locations, and other useful data that will help immerse you in the ruined remains of Site-113. The scanning mechanic is also being tested for use on SCPs and other objects in the environment to help gather useful intelligence.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Chapter 02 Cinematic Animations:[/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="8dhjbs_uepk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Marking a milestone in Chapter 02's development, we have begun to create the intro animations that will start this chapter off with a literal bang. We cannot wait to create the other sequences and animations that will elevate this chapter to be very memorable. As usual, we look forward to hearing your feedback on all of the upcoming sequences as we make them, so be sure to leave any thoughts in the comments![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Site-113's MTF Squad:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_139561a765fd43c4bcabf4a3ae60daf4~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_2560,h_2048,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_139561a765fd43c4bcabf4a3ae60daf4~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_a20dfdd59e3844b3bad4c6193b5b6ba1~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_2560,h_2048,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_a20dfdd59e3844b3bad4c6193b5b6ba1~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_e91f396c68454186a12039c7db19b00c~mv2.png"][/img]
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_34c6bf49837a49659c1047e440ab73ed~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_2560,h_2048,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_34c6bf49837a49659c1047e440ab73ed~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p]Site-113, like any Foundation site, has a distinct squad of MTF Soldiers assigned to it. Due to the unique environmental circumstances of Site-113, the local squad is equipped with specialized suits capable of withstanding the pressure changes of space as well as high-speed impacts from low-gravity debris. This also helps them survive encounters with the extremely hostile anomalies Site-113 is known for housing. Interestingly enough, what's left of these soldiers are all under the command of one individual, who you will meet as part of a really fun sequence we have planned![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Assistant Robot:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_1aa54e98169d4c10af801835bfee451a~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_1aa54e98169d4c10af801835bfee451a~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_60912118f74a47d2918a6dfce010f611~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_60912118f74a47d2918a6dfce010f611~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_cb0a7ccdee3d4946b59486ce873cac74~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_3840,h_2160,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_cb0a7ccdee3d4946b59486ce873cac74~mv2.webp"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A new character is making its debut in all its robotic glory: the Assistant Robot. These units will be scattered throughout the game and are sometimes interactable, offering dialogue or even missions should you choose to accept them. Helping these bots can be highly rewarding, so if you happen across one, make sure you see what it has to say.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Upcoming Character Teasers:[/b][/h3][p]We are currently in production on short teaser trailers for two SCPs that will be making their debut in Chapter 2. While we're excited to showcase both, one of them is an iconic anomaly we know the community has been waiting for, and we cannot wait to reveal what we have in store![/p][p]
To be the first to see these trailers the moment they drop, make sure you subscribe to our YouTube channel: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@SCPFM"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Upcoming Playtest 01:[/b][/h3][p]We are approaching a very exciting point in development: we are going to be starting the first early round of PLAYTESTING! Since many of the core story sequences are still being worked on, this first playtest will be reserved for our highest-tier backers so they can help us sniff out major design issues and bugs before we open it up to everyone else who has Early Access playtesting in their tier.[/p][p][/p][p][b]However, if you want to join us for playtesting, you are able to do that here with the $50 tier and beyond: [/b][/p][p][url="https://hst-studios.pledgemanager.com/projects/scp-fragmented-minds/participate/"]https://hst-studios.pledgemanager.com/projects/scp-fragmented-minds/participate/[/url][/p][p][/p][p](If you already backed at $50 and above, then you are good to go! If you need any help upgrading your tier, please send us a message on PledgeManager, and we will get it handled for you.)[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What's Next?[/b][/h3][p]For the rest of this month and leading into our next update, our focus will be on several key areas: completing the new SCP and MTF models, rigorously testing the Wrist Device and SRA mechanics, and finalizing the architecture and props that will fully encapsulate Chapter 02. Alongside this, we'll be actively testing all these new mechanics and creating a ton more animations and VFX as we start piecing together the exciting sequential events planned for this new chapter.[/p][p][/p][p]Chapter 02 is shaping up to be a really exciting installment, packed with many new features and elements suggested by the plethora of feedback we got from Chapter 01! This chapter will introduce a significant amount of new SCP lore as well as SCPs to interact with, new horror elements, and provide much deeper background details on the overarching story of the SCP Foundation and the mysteries of Site-113.[/p][p]We genuinely can't wait for everyone to get their hands on it for playtesting and to hear your feedback. We'll have a formal date announcement for that playtesting phase in the coming months, so please be on the lookout![/p][p][/p][p][b][i]PS:[/i][/b][i] Don't forget to get your playtesting access so you can get first dibs on playing Chapter 02 before it goes live! [/i][/p][p][url="https://hst-studios.pledgemanager.com/projects/scp-fragmented-minds/participate/"]https://hst-studios.pledgemanager.com/projects/scp-fragmented-minds/participate/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]As always,[/p][p][b]THANK YOU EVERYONE FOR YOUR CONTINUED SUPPORT![/b][/p]

notes.title: Chapter 02 Development Deep Dive: New Zones, Enemies & Mechanics!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

Since the last update, we have been hard at work creating the new environments, characters, and enemies that will be making their way into Chapter 02. Things have been going awesome, so let's get into the new content!

[h2]The Overseer's and Secretary's Office:[/h2]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_5f00c75806584636858fee4db7a33e8e~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_4964,h_2886,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_5f00c75806584636858fee4db7a33e8e~mv2.webp[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_4c940ee70ad54622989c6e113c02b716~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_4964,h_2903,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_4c940ee70ad54622989c6e113c02b716~mv2.webp[/img]

Locked away deep within the main area of the Central Hub lies the heavily brutalist Overseer's Office, nestled away behind the contrastingly mundane Secretary's Office. These are two critical locations you will explore after an extremely unique sequence. The information you'll uncover in these areas is not only extremely important to the story, but you will also gain access to one of the most useful tools in the entire game!

[h2]The Camp Gate:[/h2]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_85d767f13b7b4dbb8c8fc985a459cd34~mv2.png[/img]

Sealing off the rest of the Residential Zone from the main interior of Aquaponics lies the Camp Gate. This is one of the few remaining entrances used to access the MTF Camp, which is led by Amanda, whom we saw in a previous update. The gate is heavily guarded by automated security systems, so stealth and timing are paramount in this area.

[h2]Interrogation Room:[/h2]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_9ee6c9de6d614638ba59b31eaf4e0a1e~mv2.png[/img]

A frigid meat freezer located in a dark, desolate place serves as the perfect spot to "coerce" information out of would-be spies, traitors, and anybody else deemed a threat by what remains of the Foundation personnel left in Site-113.

[h2]Residential Zone West Wing:[/h2]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_86ee9876feab44b09733c6c4e4275797~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_b63dc71192284014ab6de799b03b2cac~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_2c7473363bb148b88d80aa13832dc214~mv2.png[/img]

With most of the main architecture of the West Wing completed, we decided now would be a good time to experiment with what an external look at the inside of Site-113 would be like. This has culminated in a beautiful skybox that allows players to see every single zone within Site-113 from the inside of the Residential Zone, which is canonically located in the middle of the interior dome.

There still needs to be lighting adjustments made, but the current lights from the skybox are accurate to the zone they represent and cast a very ominous but soft glow onto most of the external areas of the level. These will, however, be toned down and ultimately blended in a future update.

[h2]The Museum:[/h2]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_25b7c1523f674f2ba70939c33379a247~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_098332d4e78844a4a1fdd4104d4c8bee~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_6ca90dec510f466795e54c7815d5e5fd~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_fc3984ea61cb40a0ba039065c0ab86d9~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_db4dbc28436a45e49eae040443a673ce~mv2.png[/img]

The Museum is now finished architecturally and is awaiting a decoration and lighting pass to be made to it later on. This area is going to be filled with lore, puzzles, and some interesting items that will be quite useful if you find them. You'll also be able to see an interesting timeline of Site-113's history, which will help contextualize some of the core events that led to its creation as well as those of the SCP Foundation as a whole.

[h2]Central Zone + Elevator [Heavily WIP]:[/h2]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_c28d175844704497a47a286e623d8ef9~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_5dc492d50e264da2b28737ed93bf005f~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_db595e5c076c4d1889e2c68f3e498533~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_d8fc265fd4b24bcc94539d7ea74b00fa~mv2.png[/img]

In the center of the Residential Zone lies the Central Hub, which is a massive multi-story area featuring multiple rooms, unique puzzles, and plenty of enemies to keep you on your toes. This area is still heavily WIP and will need to have a lighting overhaul as well as a large decoration pass to fill up all of the side rooms and other areas that will make this place quite the set piece to explore in Chapter 02.

One of the special pieces in here is the new elevator, which is still WIP but is going to have a special sequence involving it that we are extremely excited for players to experience when they are playing through the level. This sequence will feature a very well-known SCP, too, and it should be quite interesting to solve.

[h2]Ventilation Hall 02 [WIP]:[/h2]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_3d68607216e8423b9ba855c4503cffeb~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_57f651caa4764601842043e3b9014188~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_cddb13e732cb40ccbb12d910deac8bf9~mv2.png[/img]

We have been designing several new areas like this ventilation area that will help players learn an upcoming mechanic. These areas feature a lot of verticality and openness to support the new movement mechanic that will be the main focus here, helping players learn its usefulness in solving puzzles and generally traversing the map.

[h2]Upcoming Area — The Plaza [Heavy WIP]:[/h2]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_12f04be2ea924a47abc710045ea169bc~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_79cfa1ccd23c4750a0233d8859efa553~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_4d17284a72fb4089a801210e92759bb8~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_db5dfd8a29884912a070f59506b7014d~mv2.png[/img]

One of the next areas we will be working on is the North Wing Plaza. This area is very open relative to the ones preceding it and will feature multiple paths, changing level structure, and plenty of interesting bits of lore and other things that should make this place very memorable, not to mention the stunning views of the Military Zone that dominate its skyline.

[h2]New Museum Props [SCP-093 and SCP-148]:[/h2]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_0bfd92730f204c5e987c2b89fe982ce7~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_0c6a506d9cd441afa8118f27e7379b3c~mv2.png[/img]

Something we have been working on recently has been a couple of special props for the museum and other areas around the map. One of these special props is related to a critical event in The SCP Foundation's history and marks the cornerstone of something that fundamentally shaped where they would go.

The keen-eyed among you will also notice that we have officially created two new SCPs, with SCP-148 and SCP-093 now having physical models in the game. While we don't want to spoil what they will be used for later on, we think a lot of people will really enjoy the current plans we have for them!

[h2]New Enemies [Security Turrets]:[/h2]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_4a44818119494b6089363db1c5c6608a~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_fbee1f21b426475dba05080f2cc14199~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_e1a643299b0546489d5b34cc4df0c5c3~mv2.png[/img]

We've officially finished the model for the new Security Turrets, which will be featured around the game, and are extremely happy with how they have turned out. The logic for these new enemies is already done, and all we need to do now is create some animations for them and link them up to the system to be ready to cause problems for players that get a little [i][b]too[/b][/i] adventurous.

[h2]New Enemy [A-34 WIP Animations]:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=xvd2G2tjvkQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We're now in the process of animating the special robotic soldier that will be featured around Site-113. This is going to be, among other things, the newest enemy type that you'll be able to face in Chapter 02 and beyond. These units will be extremely hard to kill, but through careful upgrades, stealth, and some luck, taking one down will be highly rewarding.

Once we get to the playtesting phase, feedback on the difficulty of these hostiles will be critical, and we are very excited to actually implement them into the level.

[h2]New Friend? [Assistant Android WIP]:[/h2]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_145b3b651a3242cfb419fc1606507e8b~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_3411,h_3411,al_c,q_90/b2d8d4_145b3b651a3242cfb419fc1606507e8b~mv2.webp[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_ea873d94df304c929f30d6165949792c~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_3c83b1e15a2443beb650014e3872ab65~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_5e38ab11580c45078d23e005130d123f~mv2.png[/img]

Keeping with the robotic theme, we decided to create a special type of robot called the Assistant Android. These units will be featured around the map in various circumstances, and we are planning on designing a special puzzle around them that will be quite rewarding if you manage to complete it during your time in Chapter 02. We'll be sharing more about these units once their model is completed in the next update for those curious.

[h2]Crafting Bench WIP:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=e625PPX2h6w;full][/previewyoutube]

A new mechanic upcoming in Chapter 02 will be these crafting benches, which will let you craft more complex upgrades and items, and even perform necessary repairs to your gear. These benches will use the same recipes that can be found in Chapter 01.

Sometimes, it will actually be beneficial to craft an item you can craft in your inventory at the bench instead, due to it being more efficient and using fewer resources for the same item, so be sure to watch out for them and use them to keep yourself stocked up as efficiently as possible.

We still need to make the VFX for printing weapons and items with these, but we will be working on those shortly and have some cool ideas that we think will make these stand out as a great new component to the overall experience.

[h2]Skill Tree WIP:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=YPunIu0lW0U;full][/previewyoutube]

One of the newest core mechanical features to be added to the game is this new skill tree, which will be introduced to give players a choice in which new environmental mechanics they'd like to pursue. Some of the unlockable mechanics will allow for breaking certain glass, hacking certain larger objects, and even moving large objects out of the way to allow for different paths to be unlocked.

This system is being designed to reward players for investing in certain skills and will allow some puzzles to be interacted with in different ways, potentially making them much easier as a reward for choosing a decisive path through the skill tree and for exploring the environment to find the items required to unlock new skills. The UI and associated skills are still heavily WIP, but you can expect to see them iterated on and updated as we go through the development cycle for Chapter 02.

[h2]Reality Wave and Reality Shard VFX:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=1ScTWI7522Q;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2d8d4_b03dc21f816e4bfc81fe2a0e6445610e~mv2.gif[/img]

Since reality is quite literally breaking down within Site-113, we wanted to create some new VFX that would help encapsulate this feeling. Two new ones we have made are the Reality Waves with their signature HUD distortion effect, and these new Reality Shards, which are effectively breaks in reality that have been occurring all across the facility as a result of something you will start to uncover as you progress through the game.

We are also planning on doing some other effects to showcase reality destabilizing and will have much more to show on that front as we continue. However, these effects should make the environments feel much more lively and thematically consistent with the notion that reality is breaking down.

[h2]Want ongoing early playtest access?:[/h2]

Want to join our playtesting team and get access to builds that never expire? [u]Backers at the $50+ tier on Kickstarter or PledgeManager receive permanent access to all test builds, including the upcoming Chapter 02.[/u]

[b]Grab your playtesting access here:[/b] [url=https://hst-studios.pledgemanager.com/projects/scp-fragmented-minds/participate/]HST Studios PledgeManager[/url]

[h2]What's Next?:[/h2]

For the rest of this month and leading up to our next update, our focus will be on several key areas: completing the new robot models and putting together more of the architecture that will fully encapsulate Chapter 02. Alongside this, we'll be actively testing all these new mechanics, plus creating a ton more animations and VFX as we start piecing together the exciting sequential events planned for this new chapter.

[b]We will also be showcasing a WIP system for the newest SCP enemy to be featured in the game! This upcoming one will be one of the several new SCP enemies that will be a core focus of Chapter 02 and in future chapters, so be sure to check the next announcement![/b]

Chapter 02 is currently shaping up to be a really exciting installment, packed with many new features and elements suggested by [u][b]YOUR[/b][/u] valuable feedback! It will introduce a significant amount of new SCP lore, new horror elements, and provide much deeper background details on the overarching story of the SCP Foundation and the mysteries of Site-113.

We genuinely can't wait for everyone to get their hands on it for playtesting and to hear your feedback. We'll have a formal date announcement for that playtesting phase in the coming months, so please be on the lookout!

As always,

[b]THANK YOU EVERYONE FOR YOUR CONTINUED SUPPORT![/b]

[b][b]PS:[/b] Don't forget to grab your playtesting access here to get in on Chapter 02 early!
[url=https://hst-studios.pledgemanager.com/projects/scp-fragmented-minds/participate/]HST Studios PledgeManager[/url][/b]

notes.title: The First 60 Days
notes.content:
It's been two months since the biggest event in our studio's history: the official Early Access launch of [b]SCP: Fragmented Minds[/b], and we could not be happier with the reception so far! The game is holding an incredible [b]93% positive rating[/b] on Steam with well over 600 reviews, completely blowing away our expectations.

We want to thank everyone for the amazing support and also outline what players can expect in the upcoming months as we gear up for Chapter 02. Let's dive into what's coming!

[h2]Reflecting on Chapter 01's Launch[/h2]

The launch for Chapter 01 went very well, and we were thrilled by the number of players, streamers, and YouTubers who decided to give the game a try! Watching people play live during that first week was extremely helpful. Combined with the feedback from the many players who joined our Discord and used the Steam discussion pages, we managed to patch out quite a few bugs very quickly!

These critical bug reports helped significantly polish the experience, and we are truly grateful for everyone who played, provided feedback, or simply told friends about the project. Your contributions will continue to be extraordinarily valuable throughout the game's development, and we can't wait to bring you Chapter 02 and take this journey all the way to 1.0 and beyond!

[h2]Chapter 01 Feedback[/h2]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_8e9ac68f09724584819384758667b0cc~mv2.gif[/img]
The feedback we received on the first chapter was phenomenal and has helped immensely in planning the pacing, SCPs, and story elements that will feature in Chapter 02 and beyond. However, we have also made several changes to Chapter 01, set to be introduced in a small update shortly. These adjustments aim to improve tension, music, and environmental interactions, as well as hint at a particular character featured in upcoming chapters – we'll let you discover these specifics once the update is launched!

As development continues, you can also expect some small adjustments to Chapter 01 to ensure everything lines up correctly with future content. Rest assured, the chapter itself won't see major changes to its story or encounters; most tweaks will focus on performance enhancements and atmosphere.

[h2]Chapter 02's Plans[/h2]

About two months prior to launching Chapter 01, the team began working on Chapter 02. This next chapter picks up right where the first left off, finally letting players take their first steps into Site-113 – where the majority of the game will unfold. This is where we plan to introduce the rest of the story, crank up the horror, bring in SCPs you know and love (plus some new ones!), and introduce more gameplay mechanics that we are [b]VERY[/b] excited about!

Chapter 02 will feature several key new elements, which we'll go over below, alongside showcasing some new concept art and fresh environments.

[h3]Chapter 02 [Tunnels WIP][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_15013587d78643e497e3f172ffcc3380~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_15013587d78643e497e3f172ffcc3380~mv2.png[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_38634fba9f4449aa90b66e572a270e55~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_38634fba9f4449aa90b66e572a270e55~mv2.png[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_f90558a12b4a4675a298104494c507d6~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_f90558a12b4a4675a298104494c507d6~mv2.png[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_42bab0b82c864cefb1cac52d7808075f~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_42bab0b82c864cefb1cac52d7808075f~mv2.png[/img]
In the tunnels, players will learn some interesting new lore that will prove [b]VERY[/b] important later on. They will also use core mechanics again in a short interaction, building upon them with a new addition to their mechanical roster – but we'll leave exactly what that is for you to discover when you play.

[h3]Chapter 02 [West Wing WIP][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_58f0229c01984da484093bb395bb22ad~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_1110,h_623,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_58f0229c01984da484093bb395bb22ad~mv2.jpg[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_24df415b86cd4255824ea427fa071f7d~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_1110,h_617,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_24df415b86cd4255824ea427fa071f7d~mv2.jpg[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_25708ad74cdb4636969375ab4213c9e2~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_25708ad74cdb4636969375ab4213c9e2~mv2.png[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_d8b49010f0794af7ba3456a7e486f9b4~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_d8b49010f0794af7ba3456a7e486f9b4~mv2.png[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_59912540f83f4ea0b6940bd86829c5ee~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_59912540f83f4ea0b6940bd86829c5ee~mv2.png[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_fe540195c1064b46a1d206c5ff338f52~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_fe540195c1064b46a1d206c5ff338f52~mv2.png[/img]
The West Wing is one of the earlier parts of Chapter 02 and introduces some interesting new interactions, along with the new, more open level design we have adopted to increase player choice in the paths they'd like to take. This approach ensures both stealth and combat styles are supported and also allows players to open up their own paths by interacting with elements in the environment.

[h3]Chapter 02 [The Museum][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_f989e6e487fa4d51ba174991d2c72551~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_468,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_f989e6e487fa4d51ba174991d2c72551~mv2.png[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_044915d95ec44b3781bf89efe0d14d37~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_468,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_044915d95ec44b3781bf89efe0d14d37~mv2.png[/img]
In Chapter 02, we plan on massively expanding the SCP, Site-113, and SCP Foundation lore. Within the museum, you can find interesting details about Site-113's history, as well as specifics on the objects that have shaped the SCP Foundation into what we know it as today. There will also be side puzzles and interesting interactions within the museum, making it a compelling place to explore and begin piecing together the larger narrative.

[h3]Chapter 02 [The Elevator][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_4354456fbebf4e919f4ee0273d5b5f72~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_683,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_4354456fbebf4e919f4ee0273d5b5f72~mv2.png[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_363a4d28d4ca4169b4df2a77e0ba1774~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_675,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_363a4d28d4ca4169b4df2a77e0ba1774~mv2.png[/img]
Part of the new Central Residential Area contains a very important elevator featuring a fun sequence that we cannot wait for players to experience! Work on the central areas is also nearly complete, which means Chapter 02 is currently coming together well ahead of schedule!

You'll see some additional map changes included in the next update too, so stick around to see those when they drop!

[h2]New Characters & Mechanics[/h2]

[h3]New Character [A-34 Android][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_52beb822587f4beab3b2a7fd4b58f9e5~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_52beb822587f4beab3b2a7fd4b58f9e5~mv2.png[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_37aae5323073445eafa50fdff6d436f2~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_37aae5323073445eafa50fdff6d436f2~mv2.png[/img]
Among the newest characters coming to the game are these autonomous A-34 androids, lovingly known as "Reapers" among Site-113 personnel. These androids will be heavily armored targets – extremely difficult yet highly rewarding to take on when encountered. As you progress through the game, you will also find additional tools and weapons to deal with them, so always keep an ear out for their signature mechanical movement.

[h3]New Character [MTF Nu-1 "Aegis Protocol"][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_671501672ca54b5993664bdcbaefb8b9~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_654,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_671501672ca54b5993664bdcbaefb8b9~mv2.png[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_ca8e03b0163a41b59dd7885bfb4ea72f~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_719,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_ca8e03b0163a41b59dd7885bfb4ea72f~mv2.png[/img]
We're also excited to introduce MTF forces in Chapter 02 and beyond. They will help tell the story of Site-113 and appear in the environment as discoverable bodies, lending weight and atmosphere to the surroundings – and perhaps even serving as an infection vector for a certain creature later on...

These characters are also planned for the multiplayer component down the line, once development shifts to that experience. For now, however, we remain squarely focused on the singleplayer story to avoid diluting either experience, as we work to make the campaign as interesting and fun as possible.

[h3]New Mechanics [Security Cameras][/h3]

[previewyoutube=IH9GWIIpd4k;full][/previewyoutube]
The hacking PDA can now hack certain cameras, allowing players to gain entry into otherwise inaccessible places through a new feature called [b]camera chaining[/b]. This enables more optional puzzles and increased world interaction, since you'll be able to more accurately see and assess threats before diving headfirst into them.

The PDA is also due to receive an upgrade for scanning certain objects. This scan can provide more details on the object and may even assign a new side mission related to it.

[h3]New Mechanics [Weapon Upgrades][/h3]

[previewyoutube=hzuzP2Iitq4;full][/previewyoutube][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_3fcda83c49cd42b09b1faaccd52e82e6~mv2.gif[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_8123717f637746c09fa9712ae92f7525~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_663,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_8123717f637746c09fa9712ae92f7525~mv2.png[/img]
One of the newest upgrades introduced in Chapter 01 (inspired by significant player feedback) is the enhanced weapon system. This will be built upon further in Chapter 02 with the addition of [b]Crafting Benches[/b] and new weapons/tools to upgrade. This system allows you to create powerful modifications for certain weapons, potentially granting unique effects during combat.

Crafting Benches will be the main hubs where you'll upgrade future equipment, repair weapons, and ultimately create the tools you rely on for survival. You'll continue to find blueprints throughout the game too, so check every corner – you never know where you might find something extremely powerful!

[h2]The Art Gallery and Community Events[/h2]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_f891ceaec3454d8d8f67cc75e906bc6e~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_f891ceaec3454d8d8f67cc75e906bc6e~mv2.png[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_ba68ff7e81024309a1b64f704950f867~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_ba68ff7e81024309a1b64f704950f867~mv2.png[/img][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_58e8133bf328425ba776f66f1d65421f~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_58e8133bf328425ba776f66f1d65421f~mv2.png[/img]
Located within the decrepit walls of Chapter 02 lies the art gallery... This place was once the premier location for Site-113 and the SCP Foundation to display works by many fine artists from Earth and beyond. However, it now lies dormant and without purpose – which is where [b]YOU[/b] might come in!

We're excited to explore the possibility of new [b]Community Events[/b]! These would allow players like you to win cool prizes and even get your art featured in-game for thousands (and perhaps one day, many more) to see!

Details about community events will be posted across our social media channels, so be sure to follow us there so you don't miss out!

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

We are beyond thrilled with the reception to Chapter 01! We've been eagerly watching the many videos made by YouTubers and streamers, and this feedback has given us a very clear idea of what can be improved and where Chapter 02 and beyond should head in terms of gameplay and story elements that tie everything together with the SCP Foundation.

Chapter 02 will delve much deeper into SCPs, lore, and game mechanics, and we cannot wait for everyone to get their hands on it at launch.

[h2]Early Chapter 02 Playtesting?[/h2]

We've had many players asking how they can playtest Chapter 02 before its release. Luckily, there is still time to get the Kickstarter/Pledgemanager perk for playtesting access, which you can find here in the [b]$50 tier and above[/b]: [url=https://hst-studios.pledgemanager.com/projects/scp-fragmented-minds/participate/]https://hst-studios.pledgemanager.com/projects/scp-fragmented-minds/participate/[/url]

If you're already a backer with this perk, you will have ongoing playtest access!

[h2]Closing[/h2]

Thank you, everyone, for your amazing support for this project and for sharing your ideas, struggles, and fun moments with us – it has been incredible to watch this game and community come alive, and we are so excited to take everything to the next level in future chapters! You can expect more exciting trailers and other content updates in the coming months, so be sure to follow along!

[b]SEE YOU ALL IN THE NEXT UPDATE![/b]

notes.title: Hotfix V0.11b NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Below we have our first-ever hotfix for SCP: Fragmented Minds. We have been working extremely hard over the last week watching videos, reading reviews, and checking discussion posts to see the biggest points of pain for players and we have since edited some areas of the level and added various features that we think will address some of the biggest issues players were facing on Day 1. 

There will be a couple more patches for stuttering, general performance and more coming too so these are just the start to a slew of big fixes that will be in Chapter 01 and you can expect many more throughout the life of the game! 


[b]NOTE:[/b] This update is [b]NOT[/b] save compatible due to changes in the map, if you have a current save of the game -- make sure to play on New Game so you don't get locked by map changes conflicting with your save data! 


[b]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/b]

[b]Crashes and Stability:[/b]
- Fixed 14 crashes across various areas of the game.
- Applied a fix for sublevels sometimes failing to load.
- Fixed an issue where a save could get corrupted in the Skybridge area.

[b]AI Behavior:[/b]
- Fixed an issue where the Elder and Scout AI would constantly shuffle when trying to rotate toward the player while directly in front of them.
- Fixed AI visual detection through walls.
- Fixed an issue where the Elder would send the player to a random location during the tackle attack.
- World objects (e.g., fire extinguishers) now properly alert AI when hitting walls or the ground.
- Explosions now correctly alert nearby AI.

[b]Gameplay and Interactions:[/b]
- Improved door interactions: Doors can now be closed by looking through the frame.
- Fixed power core sockets not loading correctly under certain conditions.
- Increased wrench range by 20 centimeters.
- Fixed an issue where the inventory could disappear after the collapsed hallway cutscene.  
  - [b]Dev Note:[/b] This was a rare but serious issue that we couldn’t reproduce internally. As a safeguard, we’ve added a save spot before the cutscene, creating a separate save slot players can return to if their inventory disappears.
- Exiting a computer screen playing an audio log no longer stops the audio log.
- Starting a different audio log from the game menu while another is playing will now stop the currently playing log.
- Removed an extraneous button from the Parking Garage.
- Removed interaction prompts and lights from most of the Hangar’s doors.
- Fixed an issue where the energy drink was healing instead of restoring stamina, as described.

[b]UI and Accessibility:[/b]
- Added an option for keyboard users to customize PDA input bindings.
- Improved elevator interaction text to clarify when there’s no power or if the elevator is in motion.
- Added hints to the Codex for better player guidance.

---

[b]World Polish and Improvements:[/b]

[b]Environment Detailing:[/b]
- Added more detail to the Gen Room, including papers on the floor in security/office rooms, grunge in empty areas, and objects on previously empty shelves.
- Adjusted the blue lights in the Server Room ceiling to make the main screens stand out more.
- Added flares to a few containers, allowing players to use flares before crafting them.
- Fixed a random cart prop in the Gen Room hallway that was clipping into a wall.

[b]Lighting and Visuals:[/b]
- Changed the vent light in the Gen Room puzzle area to blue for better visibility.
- Made the light in the vent above the hallway more visible to help players notice it when sneaking past the last Scout enemy.
- Dimmed the orange light shining on the map in the Flooded Tunnels to prevent it from washing out the image.
- Adjusted the glass transparency in the Hangar Control Room by 20%.

[b]Collision and Navigation:[/b]
- Edited collision around the biomass in Storage Room B area.
- Fixed collision of the Broken Fan Cover and Semi Trucks in the chase sequence to prevent players from getting stuck.
- Adjusted collision around lamps in the platforming section in the chase sequence area.
- Added collision volumes behind Pressure Tanks in the Transition Room to prevent players from jumping behind them and getting stuck.
- Edited collision around rails in the Chase Sequence tunnels to prevent players from getting stuck.
- Fixed collision in the second Semi Truck in the platforming area to make mantling easier.
- Adjusted the Gate in the Hangar Lounge to fix a small crack in the wall.
- Fixed the door at the bottom of the staircase in the Gen Room, which was 10% too small.
- Added collision volumes around the blocked path next to the platforming section entrance.

[b]Gameplay Tweaks:[/b]
- Reduced the damage from electric water in the Collapsed Tunnel chase sequence to account for players falling in more often.
- Made some jumps in the platforming section slightly easier.
- Added a second Fire Extinguisher at the start of the second half of the game for experimentation.
- Covered the bottoms of Semi Trucks in the chase sequence to prevent players from hiding under them.
- Ensured all barrels could be blown up when hitting them with the wrench.
- Fixed the Fire Extinguisher in the left side entrance not being able to be picked up.
- Flipped monitor textures in the Storage Room A office rooms.
- Prevented players from skipping the Crane Controls in Storage Room B.
- Edited the layout of the Elder Combat Room to prevent players from jumping onto the Pressure Tank and avoiding the Elder.
-Made the Security Room in the Collapsed Hallway area darker

[b]Audio and Props:[/b]
- Moved the Beacon closer to the exit door in the Hangar to make it appear as if the audio is coming from it rather than over the comms.
- Changed the first Hacking Router in Chapter 01 to have a blue light (matching all other routers).
- Added shutters to the Security Room of the Gen Room area to make it feel less exposed 
[b]Miscellaneous:[/b]
- Fixed leaf textures clipping through the wall in the first Locker Room on the left side.

---

This update focuses on improving stability, fixing large bugs, and enhancing the overall polish of the game. We hope these changes make your experience smoother and more enjoyable. As always, please continue to share your feedback with us since it’s invaluable in helping us make the game the best it can be!

notes.title: April/May Polish Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey everyone![/b][/h3]


These last two months have mainly focused on playtesting and creating/polishing some of the final mechanics and areas that will be visited throughout Chapter One. We have also been hard at work on some fun cinematic and gameplay animations that will make the environment more interactive as you make your way through it. 


[h3][b]Playtesting Information:[/b][/h3]

About a week ago, we started doing a 2nd large-scale playtest with all of the Kickstarter backers and some third parties, and have begun to modify things in the game based on that invaluable feedback. The first couple of playtests are always a bit nerve-wracking as reports of extremely strange bugs and enemy interactions come in, but we are happy to say that we have ironed out most of the major issues and will be continuing to improve based on feedback until launch -- and then for the foreseeable future after that! 


[h3][b]New Cinematic Animations: [/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=g26o0FNIuM4;full][/previewyoutube]

Since we have started to work on the actual sequence that will take place in Chapter 1, we wanted to begin setting up some of the animations that will play and give life to the events that take place in this chapter. 


There are a couple more cinematic animations to do, but these above are some of the smaller ones we are about to implement for some events that happen to the player as they make their way into Site-113. 


[h3][b]Prop Animations: [/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=XZH-ZaQQe7I;full][/previewyoutube]

Along with a couple of new animations for the player, we have also been working on creating some animations for various props that will be encountered throughout the game. These interactable and animated props help breathe life into the environment, and we are very excited for players to encounter them since they're all included in some pretty important sequences. 


A couple of these props still need their sounds implemented, which you will see as a general theme throughout most of the videos, but luckily we will be working on a large sound overhaul this month and the next -- so things should start coming together for that pretty quickly. 


[h3][b]New Props [Bathroom]:[/b][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_2a0564f3953941ff991c9c48dc4238e2~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_2a0564f3953941ff991c9c48dc4238e2~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_999bab49b54e414daeeac3ef7e76f453~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_999bab49b54e414daeeac3ef7e76f453~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_e918a21a972c4272a8dc05f9b66dfc10~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_e918a21a972c4272a8dc05f9b66dfc10~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_a5c0297e189e4377a54dbab9c10ca895~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_a5c0297e189e4377a54dbab9c10ca895~mv2.png[/img]

We've recently created some props for various types of bathrooms that players can find throughout the game, this was mainly to give spaces a "lived-in" feeling and allow certain areas of the facility to look as though they would be part of an actual massive facility housing thousands of employees. 


Some of these props are planned to be interactable too, so we encourage players to attempt to mess around with them and see if they can figure out how to "break" them open. 


[h3][b]New Props [Oil Spills, Signage, Cords]:[/b][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_ccc1d0d2f12e416a8b626480fe480218~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_953,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_ccc1d0d2f12e416a8b626480fe480218~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_79315013212541cbac561ab822d7707a~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_648,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_79315013212541cbac561ab822d7707a~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_71ddfadfa54b42e58c4966590ceada02~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_1221,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_71ddfadfa54b42e58c4966590ceada02~mv2.png[/img]

In order to populate the environments more and give extra details to certain areas, we have been working on some extra props to fill in some areas with things that make sense and, as we will see a little later in this post, can also have a pretty large impact on gameplay if used correctly. 


We've been creating some signage to help guide players around the facility too, as well as a couple of fans and other props which will be animated and make things feel even more alive in the areas you'll be visiting.


[h3][b]Quintet Soda and Vending Machine: [/b][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_87f8fbe0b10d4fbba7032cea60a62430~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_465,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_87f8fbe0b10d4fbba7032cea60a62430~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_029bfdc8a22f4a5a95b5bd6dc92afab1~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_650,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_029bfdc8a22f4a5a95b5bd6dc92afab1~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_b6336d54e9114100a4a7ff0ac622eb01~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_473,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_b6336d54e9114100a4a7ff0ac622eb01~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_84f72b334a9143e2812e1ec080edcd9d~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_365,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_84f72b334a9143e2812e1ec080edcd9d~mv2.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=NM2tPkYxPxU;full][/previewyoutube]

Because we are kind of obsessed with small details, we have been working on an in-universe soda/energy drink company called Quintet. You'll be able to find and purchase various drinks from vending machines located around the facility, and this mechanic should even be available in Chapter One! 


These drinks have a small use too, and they'll be able to restore some health or give a temporary boost to energy depending on the version you come across. For reference, the Quintet+ bottles are the energy drink version which will give a small boost to stamina while the normal Quintet bottles contain the soda variation which will heal you. 


The vending machines themselves help introduce the idea of an in-universe currency system that will be stored on your special keycard and available to see in your Codex. This currency will be used to purchase things from vending machines like these and also used to buy things from merchants -- so be sure to have some spare credits! 


[h3][b]Information Kiosk: [/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=e1USEyib8ag;full][/previewyoutube]

We've been working on some fun interactable signage that will display information about various containment chambers, locations, and facts that players can take a look at throughout their journey in the site. These kiosks can also sometimes have interactable buttons that will impact something in the environment --- so if you see one be sure to take a closer look! 


[h3][b]SCP-3199's Fleshy Nests: [/b][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_583e3ec372824bb88aa23f69e5d44188~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_583e3ec372824bb88aa23f69e5d44188~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_891388d1317044fc85498cf096eec458~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_891388d1317044fc85498cf096eec458~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_583068b7d11a4640884b70747388f347~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_583068b7d11a4640884b70747388f347~mv2.png[/img]

To really amp up the SCP-3199 environments, we've started creating some subtle fleshy tendrils and other bits that are used by SCP-3199s as a safe place to nest and lay their special eggs. It's in these nests that you can expect to find a very large infestation of the creatures with the Elder variants being particularly aggressive to protect their young. 


These areas are still WIP but the flesh is pretty much done and ready to be placed around the nests and surrounding areas to create a very disgusting location that will be an interesting place to traverse regardless of the playstyle you choose. 


[h3][b]Interaction Animations [Valve and Door Prying]: [/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=zTbBU48_gYM;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=S8UTjKSocCg;full][/previewyoutube]

As you roam around Site-113, you'll come across various obstacles and puzzles that need to be solved for you to progress. One example of this is the new interactable valves, which can be used to turn on or off gas lines and can be used to set traps or even block enemies off your back if used in conjunction with the welder. Of course, like a lot of the puzzles there is more than one way to solve it and fire extinguishers can simply be thrown at them to extinguish the flame and allow one to safely pass through. 


Another example of an interaction mechanic is the new pryable doors, which will be sprinkled around and used to break up certain sections by requiring the player to interact with them before they can pass through. We have a very specific use case for these in mind -- which you will all see when you play! 


Also, do not worry about the number of QTEs that are being showcased -- we are making sure to spread them out as well as adding an optional accessibility setting that will allow them to be completed by holding the corresponding button rather than tapping it. 


[h3][b]Improved Tunnel Lighting: [/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=JyKa84Hjigw;full][/previewyoutube]

As part of our ongoing improvements to the overall lighting within Chapter One, we have been experimenting with certain new lighting methods and have been able to get some very pretty water-caustic effects that are quite performance-friendly. This, along with some new post-processing and volumetric fog effects, has started to make the newly lit areas of the game look very pretty while also maintaining a lot of performance through carefully set-up static lighting. 


These areas are coming together very nicely and we cannot wait to show them off in our trailer and for you to see them in-game!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_98882fc21e4f4d33b4690659a2846aa9~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_98882fc21e4f4d33b4690659a2846aa9~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_dcbe06b390a04617bb8aaa24faddeaba~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_dcbe06b390a04617bb8aaa24faddeaba~mv2.png[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_c2d2b4ab7fe74d9e8d352239753bec5d~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_c2d2b4ab7fe74d9e8d352239753bec5d~mv2.png[/img]

In the last update, we saw this dome section coming together and we are happy to say it's now fully put together in-game! Of course, it still needs forestation, ice, and the disgusting flesh that are all staples of the three unique zones you'll be visiting in Site-113. 


We will be putting it together over the coming months though to record some really cool cinematics in there, so you can expect to see updates with this massive area for the next couple of months! 


[h3][b]New Mechanics [Fire Propagation and Fire Extinguishers]: [/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=XG1kaufJE_I;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=ZjqSCR7xPF8;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=TuZk27IOpDw;full][/previewyoutube]


Interaction with the environment is a core gameplay pillar of SCP: Fragmented Minds, and we have been designing some new mechanics to allow players to actually utilize their environment to trap enemies or even impact the environment itself to open up new ways through levels. 


We've created a new system for fire that allows the welder to be used essentially as a match to ignite puddles of oil or gas leaks -- which can have devastating effects if there are any nearby flammable objects. 


However, to also allow players to put out the fires that will exist in the environment, we have also set up new fire extinguishers that can be used to extinguish flames and even freeze enemies -- a mechanic we used in the demo we released way back when and wanted to bring back! 


The sounds for these mechanics will be implemented shortly too, so stick around to hear how those will sound since we are using a new audio middleware program that gives a lot finer grain control over how audio sounds than we previously had. 


[h3][b]Combat Mechanic Update [Damage Animations]: [/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=bwnG4l4glOk;full][/previewyoutube]


We have been doing some playtesting recently, and a lot of testers wanted us to add animations to help understand when they are actually doing damage to enemies. Since then, we have created a procedural animation system that will play when hitting an enemy and makes it extremely apparent when you have done damage to an enemy and when they are stunned. 


[h3][b]Physics-Driven Doors:  [/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=fzyDWroXTLw;full][/previewyoutube]

While most of the doors you'll see around the game are variations of airlocks or vent hatches, we wanted a type of door that can be affected by the environment and by enemies. We have since made a special type of door that can simply be opened just by walking through it or kicking it but can also be opened by props and various random creatures that might want to take a peek at what's behind them. 


[h3][b]Crane Platforms: [/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=dLEcOGMxXvE;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several areas in the game where platforming is absolutely encouraged and a new feature will be a form of moving crane platforms that can be used to traverse the environment in different ways -- or can be used to get back up to a certain spot if you're unfortunate enough to have fallen down. Platforms like this will usually need to be activated and powered through a crane controller, so make sure to always look around for one nearby. 


[h3][b]Controller Support: [/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=0l5ofbLvd7Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Something we have been working on recently is ensuring the game has controller support natively baked in, and we are happy to report that we are starting to switch up all the controls to be compatible with controller and making sure they are hot swappable so players can pick and choose how they want to play without the inconvenience of needing to restart to switch input methods.


This is still heavily WIP but it's coming along quite nicely and we are so excited to see players able to use multiple input methods to play how they like! 


[h3][b]UI Overhaul: [/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=Ry1cTDqtOGI;full][/previewyoutube]

We have begun switching over all the developer testing UI to the actual final UI designs that will be found throughout the entire game, and we just finished up with the save station UI and hacking PDA UI and are currently in the process of finishing up the inventory UI. 


There are still a couple more big UI pieces like the HUD and settings menus that need to be finished up, but you can expect to see those likely in the next update! 


[h3][b]SCP-049:[/b][/h3]

It's a loosely kept secret that we have officially finished our design of SCP-049, and while we would love to share all the fun images of him here, we want to really do him justice and will be making a small animated reveal trailer with his design instead! You can expect that in the coming months, so make sure to subscribe to our YouTube so you don't miss that! 


[h3][b]What's coming next? [/b][/h3]

Over this month and the coming ones, we'll be doing a lot of sound implementation to get everything switched over to our new audio system. However, we will also be doing most of the remaining sequencing stuff and some fun NPC animations that have actual face motion so we can't wait to see how those turn out. We will also be finishing up the remaining UI bits and adding the last little tweaks based on playtesting that should help make the experience all the more enjoyable and fun to play. 


We're also working on getting the last remaining cutscenes and voice lines done to wrap up pretty much everything that's left before we can call Chapter One done -- and we are so incredibly excited to share it with you when it launches! 


We will have an official release date for Chapter One set [b]in the coming months[/b], so keep an eye out!


[h3][b]THANK YOU! [/b][/h3]

notes.title: January and February Mega Update!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey everyone, and welcome to another mega update![/b][/h3]


This month and last we have been hard at work getting things settled with the first official playtest, and we are very happy to share that we have made some substantial stability enhancements with this new feedback as well as some small tweaks to features and how things are presented.


[h3][b]Kickstarter Playtesting News:[/b][/h3]


One of the most nail-biting periods during the game development cycle is when players first get their hands on a playtesting copy of the game since even the most tried and tested systems are bound to break when players play just a bit differently.


During our first round of playtesting, we found plenty of bugs both big and small with some notable ones giving some very comical moments throughout the testing period. However, we released a couple of hotfixes during this time and fixed most of the large bugs, which has taken the game to a MUCH more stable state in general.


We have a vast array of notes for general improvements based on the current feedback, but of course, we are always open to more. 


For those of you Kickstarter backers who have not gotten the opportunity to test – fear not! We will be opening up testing in batches and these batches will include all Kickstarter backers from $50 and up. We are currently testing with $100 backers and up to get the big fixes out of the way and then will be adding more sequencing and finalized pieces to the game to polish it out to completion. During this time, playtesting will be open and will remain that way until launch so playtesters can test as much or as little as they’d like while we push changes to the game based on their feedback.


[h3][b]Space Hangar 07: [/b][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_80ff978a53364d5aaa22500a129c4478~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_80ff978a53364d5aaa22500a129c4478~mv2.png[/img]

[h3][b]Workplace Hazard [Unfinished Cave]: [/b][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_51d17fac391e442a8318aa66bdc5ae1e~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_51d17fac391e442a8318aa66bdc5ae1e~mv2.png[/img]

Despite a plethora of OSHA violations, Site-113 is an ever-expanding facility that needs to make room for new areas to do research, store items, and even store anomalies. In order to do this, they cut deep channels into the crust of Mars and begin to tunnel massive sections out to fortify them and prepare roadways and transport tunnels. 


In some cases, complications may arise from active magma tubes which, if left unchecked, can have catastrophic consequences for any surrounding architecture that cannot withstand the heat (human flesh included).  


[h3][b]Train Station [Non-Final Lighting]: [/b][/h3]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/77ff01_6003a7a2d1ee446d8e2525bd40e70ff4~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_1110,h_624,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/77ff01_6003a7a2d1ee446d8e2525bd40e70ff4~mv2.png[/img]

Each rail line starts and ends with a train station, which generally houses two sets of tracks for inbound and outgoing trains. 


There will be looting opportunities in these stations since they were once a bustling hub of site personnel going between the Space Hangars to the inside of the facility, and for those departing from Site-113 back to Earth.
